column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST, the same shape as TestEveryPromiseSpecRoundTripsThroughARealEventHistory in scripts/skip-ledger.tsv: the test runs one subtest per dialect and each calls testutil.TestDB, which skips when its DSN is unset, so mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name on 2026-11-20: CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES=<pg> go test ./engine/ -run TestEveryG1bSpecRoundTripsThroughARealEventHistory -count=1 -v reports exactly these two skips (SKIP .../mssql, SKIP .../mysql) and PASS .../postgres. It is the real-event_history round trip of signal_workflow, durable_send and fetch on the replay step dispatcher (cleat#4152, G1b).

dialect-gated per SUBTEST, the same shape as the test-go/engine line in this file: the round trip runs one subtest per dialect and each calls testutil.TestDB, which skips when its DSN is unset, so in the MySQL-only job the postgres and mssql arms skip and mysql RUNS -- two, not three. A specific line and not a bump of the broad /postgres$ and /mssql$ lines, per the Skip budget guard's own message (CI on this PR: "expects 426 skip(s) matching //postgres$/, got 427" and the same for //mssql$/). NOT measured locally: no MySQL is configured on the machine this was written on; the Skip budget check on this head is the measurement. cleat#4152, G1b.
